guidance.heading: Updated Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: For the full year 2026, the Company now expects total revenue of between $660 million and
$670 million, and non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA of between $137 million and $142 million. The
Company will provide additional details on its third quarter 2026 earnings call.
Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA is provided in the full year 2026 Outlook on a forward-looking
most directly comparable financial measures calculated and presented in accordance with
difficulty of projecting event driven transactional and other non-core operating items in any
future period. The magnitude of these items, however, may be significant.
